rules: Every source-evidence state is appended with its own stable stateId and never overwritten or edited in place.
A source change, correction, withdrawal, replacement or re-check appends a NEW state that references the state it supersedes.
An earlier approval always remains reconstructable from the exact state it referenced.
Stage 1 creates the structure only. It creates no sources and no completed validation.

stateFields.contentDigest: full 64-hex SHA-256 of the substantive content this evidence was gathered against
stateFields.contentVersion: authorised content version label, when one exists
stateFields.recordedAt: ISO timestamp of when this evidence state was recorded
stateFields.recordedBy: person who recorded this evidence state
stateFields.sources: array of { url, publisher, claimSupported, checkedOn, checkedBy }
stateFields.supersedes: stateId this state replaces, or null
stateFields.supersededBy: set only by appending a later state; never edited to hide history
